always @* begin
    next_state = state;

    case (state)
        IDLE: begin
            if (free_tx_bd != BD_EMPTY) begin
                next_state = GET_TX_BD;
            end else if (free_rx_bd != BD_EMPTY) begin
                next_state = GET_RX_BD;
            end else begin
                next_state = IDLE;
            end
        end

        GET_TX_BD: begin
            if ((bd_cnt > (READ_CYCLE - 1)) && (tx_full == 1'b1)) begin
                next_state = SEND_CMD;
            end else begin
                next_state = GET_TX_BD;
            end
        end

        GET_RX_BD: begin
            if (bd_cnt >= (READ_CYCLE - 1)) begin
                next_state = SEND_CMD;
            end else begin
                next_state = GET_RX_BD;
            end
        end

        SEND_CMD: begin
            if (send_done == 1'b1) begin
                next_state = RECIVE_CMD;
            end else begin
                next_state = SEND_CMD;
            end
        end

        RECIVE_CMD: begin
            if ((rec_done == 1'b1) ||
                ((!cmd_busy) && (!cmd_tsf_err) && (card_status[0] == 1'b1) &&
                 ((card_status[4:1] == 4'd4) ||
                  (card_status[4:1] == 4'd5) ||
                  (card_status[4:1] == 4'd6)))) begin
                next_state = DATA_TRANSFER;
            end else if ((rec_failed == 1'b1) ||
                         ((!cmd_busy) && cmd_tsf_err) ||
                         ((!cmd_busy) && (card_status[0] == 1'b1) &&
                          !((card_status[4:1] == 4'd4) ||
                            (card_status[4:1] == 4'd5) ||
                            (card_status[4:1] == 4'd6)))) begin
                next_state = SEND_CMD;
            end else begin
                next_state = RECIVE_CMD;
            end
        end

        DATA_TRANSFER: begin
            if (trans_done == 1'b1) begin
                next_state = IDLE;
            end else if (trans_failed == 1'b1) begin
                next_state = STOP;
            end else begin
                next_state = DATA_TRANSFER;
            end
        end

        STOP: begin
            next_state = STOP_SEND;
        end

        STOP_SEND: begin
            if (send_done == 1'b1) begin
                next_state = IDLE;
            end else begin
                next_state = STOP_SEND;
            end
        end

        default: begin
            next_state = IDLE;
        end
    endcase
end
